cases.expected: Needs you first: Customer 3 (site visit to confirm) and Customer 4 (negotiation), each with a reason and a calm holding line in its own copy box. Routine drafts for 2, 5 and 6 use only the given facts. Office hours saved as one quick reply (asked twice). Ends with a one-line count.

checks.value: Customer 3 (site visit) and Customer 4 (better deal) are under Needs you, each with a one-line reason and a holding line of 25 words or fewer that promises nothing; office hours are drafted and saved as one quick reply because Customers 2 and 5 asked the same thing.
